channel.title: Chunyuan Deng — Blog
channel.description: Blog posts from Chunyuan Deng. Publication dates are approximate: the archive provides only the month, represented here as its first day in UTC.

item.title: Reading a Pretraining Run
item.description: What to watch in a large run and in what order: definitions, aggregation semantics, sampling cadence, and a priority for every optimization, tensor, routing, modality, system, and evaluation metric.

item.title: Transformers Are (Naively) Looped Transformers, Horizontally
item.description: The standard Transformer applies the same weights at every sequence position — making it a horizontally looped, time-recurrent architecture. The natural generalization assigns per-position weight matrices. TTT realizes this via gradient descent, and turns out to be LocoProp applied along the time axis.

item.title: Rethinking Key-Value Relationships in Linear Attention
item.description: We tested how DeltaNet handles diverse key-value relationships from identity to exponentials, scaling up to 32,000 tokens. Under standard normalized conditions, DeltaNet stays remarkably stable whether values come from k² or e^k. Information theory explains the bounds: DeltaNet retains 99.6% of information for identity but only 1.2% for exponentials, revealing fundamental compression limits.

item.title: The ABC Research Mindset
item.description: A simple debiasing trick for judging new research ideas. By reordering the timeline of proposals, we can strip away the novelty premium and compare ideas on their actual merits. Applied to latent reasoning and transformer architecture debates.
